$comment: Where this database is published and where its source lives. Everything that needs a URL derives it from here, so moving the site is one edit rather than a search across the generator.
$comment_url: No custom domain required. GitHub Pages serves a project site from a subdirectory, which works because every internal link the generator emits is a bare filename — the site does not care what it is hosted under. Set this to a custom domain later and nothing else has to change.
